items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 20 August 2026 at 4:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

High pressure in the mid-Atlantic and low pressure in the North Sea as various fronts and troughs affect the British Isles.


##Wind##

North or northeast 4 or 5, occasionally 6 at first, soon backing north or northwest, decreasing 2 to 4 overnight into tomorrow.


##State of Sea##

Slight occasionally moderate, becoming slight later.


##Weather##

Occasional showers becoming isolated.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

North or northwest 2 to 4, occasionally 5 in the west later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate in the west later.


##Weather##

Occasional showers, mainly in the south, soon becoming isolated.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in showers.
